title: Keto Christmas Board
seo_title: Keto Christmas Charcuterie Board (Wreath): Shopping & Plan
description: A keto Christmas charcuterie wreath for 12: brie, cheddar, Gouda, blue cheese, prosciutto, salami, soppressata, rosemary and raspberries. About 5 g net carbs a serving.
hook: A showpiece for the Christmas table: a keto board built as a wreath, with rosemary greenery and red berries.
why: The wreath shape does the decorating: a ring of cheeses and meats with rosemary tucked in as greenery and raspberries as the red. Four cheeses (brie, cheddar, Gouda and blue) and three meats feed twelve.
Parmesan crisps, cucumbers and celery are the low-carb dippers, and pecans and green olives fill the gaps. The rosemary is decoration, not food. About 5 g net carbs per serving.

timeline.what: Take out the cheddar, gouda and blue cheese.
Lay a ring of rosemary on the board as the wreath base.
Take out the brie. Slice the cucumbers and celery.
Take out the meats; fold the salami and soppressata.
Fill the center with raspberries. Serve.

faq.q: How do you make a charcuterie wreath?
faq.a: Set a small bowl in the center of a round board, then build a ring of cheese, folded meats, vegetables and berries around it, tucking rosemary in as greenery. Remove the bowl at the end.
Yes. It uses vegetables and parmesan crisps instead of crackers and berries instead of jam. About 5 g net carbs per serving for 12.
Slice everything the day before and keep it covered in the fridge. Build the wreath within an hour of guests arriving.
